quests.title: Know Your Mushrooms
quests.intro: Bram eats first and asks later, which is how he learned. This time, ask.

steps.text: Fill a sack with six mushrooms.

quests.title: Beast and Bounty
quests.intro: Some things in the grove bite back. Bram does not mind a scrap if the larder is better for it.

steps.text: Have two spore sacs on hand.

quests.title: Feast of the Hungry
quests.intro: Bram's table is never empty, and a good cook (Oren has the knack) makes it a feast. Cook, then share with the hermit.

steps.text: Cook a pot of sporebean rations.
Share a ration with a hermit and take what he offers.
Plant three sporebean seeds in the grove.

reward.title: Larder-Lord
reward.text: Forage finds one more mushroom each time
